title: cytisus supinus var. angustifolius
intro: Cytisus supinus var. angustifolius, commonly known as Scotch broom, is a flowering plant belonging to the pea family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Cytisus supinus var. angustifolius include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and possess antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, this plant is used to treat various conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders, primarily due to its sedative and antispasmodic actions. The bioactive constituents of Cytisus supinus var. angustifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
